name: vibebud-monorepo
description: Top-level scripts for building and running vibebud's core (web) and desktop shells.

scripts.desktop-build: npm --prefix core run build && npm --prefix desktop run build:win
scripts.desktop-build:win: npm --prefix core run build && npm --prefix desktop run build:win
scripts.desktop-build:mac: npm --prefix core run build && npm --prefix desktop run build:mac
scripts.desktop-build:linux: npm --prefix core run build && npm --prefix desktop run build:linux
scripts.desktop-run: npm run web-build && npm --prefix desktop run sync-core && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.android-sync: npm run web-build && cd mobile && npx cap sync android && cd .. && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('mobile/android/app/src/main/assets/public/installers', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.android-build: npm run android-sync && npm --prefix mobile run build
scripts.android-run: npm run web-build && cd mobile && npx cap sync && npx cap run android
scripts.install-all: npm --prefix core install && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix mobile install
